name: Mercedes-Benz Group AG
summary: Mercedes-Benz Group AG operates as a prominent global automotive manufacturer, with significant operations in Germany and across international markets. The company specializes in the design, production, and distribution of a diverse portfolio of vehicles. This extensive range includes premium and luxury passenger vehicles under its flagship Mercedes-Benz brand, encompassing high-performance Mercedes-AMG, iconic G-Class, ultra-luxury Mercedes-Maybach, and electric Mercedes-EQ lines, alongside compact smart-branded automobiles. Additionally, it offers the integrated Mercedes me digital ecosystem, commercial vans marketed under the Mercedes-Benz and Freightliner names, and corresponding spare parts and accessories. Beyond vehicle manufacturing, Mercedes-Benz Group AG provides comprehensive financial and mobility solutions. These encompass vehicle financing and leasing packages for both individual customers and dealerships, automotive insurance brokerage, and banking services. The company's mobility offerings further include car subscriptions, rental programs, fleet management, and advanced digital services for vehicle charging and payment. Established in 1886, the organization was previously known as Daimler AG until its rebranding to Mercedes-Benz Group AG in February 2022. Its global headquarters are located in Stuttgart, Germany.
